setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device on OUT 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in C major at 90 BPM, with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). The Trig params screen is open on its parameter list, showing Quantised Fixed Note; no slot is assigned yet. Quantised Fixed Note works like Fixed Note, but snaps every value to the nearest note of the active scale, here C major.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Quantised Fixed Note to the first slot and K2 to return. Slot 1 reads X, which means Off.
steps.title: Assign Quantised Fixed Note to a slot

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E3 to 60 (C3). Slot 1 reads 60, the channel's default pitch.
steps.title: Set the channel pitch

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The MIDI strip lists C3 (60) four times at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, exactly as in the Fixed Note example, because 60 is in the key.
steps.title: Play the default

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 to 63 (D#3) and release. 63 is not in C major, so the lock snaps to the nearest scale note; D3 (62) and E3 (64) are equally close and the lower one wins. Play, then stop: the strip reads 60, 62, 60, 60. The Fixed Note example plays 63 here.
steps.title: Lock step 2 to a pitch outside the key

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4), turn E3 down to 0 and release. 0 is a real pitch, not Off, and it is in the key. Play, then stop: the strip reads 0, 62, 60, 60.
steps.title: Zero is a note

steps.caption: Hold step 4 at (4,4), turn E3 down to X (Off) and release: step 4 had no lock, so nothing changes (0, 62, 60, 60 on Play and Stop). Then, with no step held, turn E3 up five detents to raise the channel pitch to 65 (F3, in the key). Play, then stop: steps 3 and 4 follow it and steps 1 and 2 keep their locks, 0, 62, 65, 65. Clearing locks and turning the channel pitch off behave exactly as in the Fixed Note example, A pitch default with local exceptions.
steps.title: Raise the default beneath the locks

title: Quantised pitch: the default and its exceptions
